description:
## Goal

Extend the shared iframe-bridge package with two new capabilities: on iframe attach, a scenario UI advertises its widget manifest to the parent (agent-inbox); the parent can request `render widget X` and the scenario UI renders only that widget's subtree per the research-defined scoping mechanism.

## Expected Work

- Add the widget-manifest message to iframe-bridge on both sides.
- Add the scoped-render directive and the selected scoping mechanism.
- Preserve backward compatibility — scenario UIs that haven't adopted widgets continue to work unchanged.
- Tests covering attach, manifest exchange, and scoped render.

## Acceptance

- A sample scenario UI with a declared widget can be iframed, advertise its manifest, and render widget X in scoped mode on request.
- Existing iframe-bridge consumers continue to work.
name: iframe-bridge-widget-handshake
title: Extend iframe-bridge with widget-manifest handshake and scoped-render directive
